q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is August 26, 2026. Today is August 18, 2026. That's **8 days** until the announcement of forward guidance.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA issued guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 of **$91.0 billion ±2%**, which translates to a range of **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**. This guidance is the most concrete current information available.

The company explicitly stated this guidance and it's now only 8 days away from the earnings release. Barring a major unexpected business development, NVIDIA typically provides guidance in a narrow range and manages to hit it within the stated margin.

The key considerations:
- The guidance was issued very recently (May 20, 2026)
- It's only 8 days until the actual earnings release
- Historical precedent shows NVIDIA generally hits its guidance ranges
- The research mentions analyst consensus ranges from $86.84B to $93.5B, but the company's own guidance of $91.0B ±2% is what matters for "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release"

The forward guidance issued at the Q2 FY2027 earnings release (August 26) will be for Q3 FY2027, not Q2. However, reading the question carefully, it asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)" — this is asking what revenue guidance will be given FOR Q2 FY2027 when those earnings are released.

Wait — let me reconsider. The timing here is:
- Today: August 18, 2026
- Q2 FY2027 earnings release: August 26, 2026 (in 8 days)

The question is asking about the forward guidance that will be issued when Q2 FY2027 earnings are released. That forward guidance would typically be for Q3 FY2027 (the next quarter).

However, the range provided (99.5 to 115.5 Billion) is significantly higher than NVIDIA's current Q2 guidance of $91.0B ±2%. This suggests the question might be asking about guidance for a later quarter, or there's ambiguity in interpretation.

Re-reading more carefully: "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?" — The most natural interpretation is: what guidance for Q3 FY2027 will be given at the Q2 earnings call?

Given:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6B
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0B (±2%)
- Expected trend: Strong growth continuing

A jump to Q3 FY2027 guidance in the $99.5-115.5B range would represent continued strong growth (roughly 9-27% from Q2 midpoint of $91B).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Unexpected weakness in AI infrastructure demand
- Increased China competition or regulatory challenges
- Supply chain disruptions for Blackwell or next-gen products
- Market saturation concerns in hyperscaler segment
- Conservative guidance due to potential slowdown signals

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger than expected Blackwell adoption continuing
- Unexpected demand surge from new customer segments
- Better than anticipated Vera CPU or new product ramp
- Continuation of the strong 9-10% sequential growth trend seen Q1→Q2
- Potential inclusion of previously excluded China revenue

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research:
- Q1 FY2027: $81.6B (actual)
- Q2 FY2027: $91.0B ±2% (current guidance, May 20, 2026)
- This represents ~11.5% sequential growth from Q1 to Q2

If this growth rate continues: $91.0B × 1.115 ≈ $101.5B for Q3 FY2027

Analyst consensus mentioned for Q2 ranges from $86.84B to $93.5B, with the company's own guidance at $91B being right in line.

---

## Probability Distribution Analysis

The range given (99.5 to 115.5B) appears to be for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance. 

Key anchors:
- **Base continuation of growth**: $91.0B × 1.10-1.15 = $100.1B - $104.65B
- **Analyst high expectations**: ~$101.5B
- **Upper bound scenario** (sustained strong growth): ~$110-115B
- **Lower bound scenario** (more conservative): ~$99.5-102B

With 8 days to the announcement, there's limited new information that would substantially change expectations. NVIDIA tends to be moderately optimistic but achievable with guidance.

The midpoint of the given range (107.5B) would imply ~18% sequential growth Q2→Q3, which seems aggressive but possible given the momentum.

More likely: guidance comes in around $101-107B range, with concentration in $103-108B.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to report its fiscal Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close, with an earnings call at 5:00 PM ET [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). This figure is above the LSEG average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), with some aggregators pegging it closer to $93.5 billion [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

NVIDIA reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion, up 85% year-over-year and 20% quarter-over-quarter, driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure, particularly Blackwell systems [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion in Q1 FY2027, with hyperscale and AI cloud/enterprise segments each contributing about half [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). The company's new Vera CPU is expected to open a new $200 billion market [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).
